cohort: 110,450 women who delivered after 28 weeks of gestation in 39 hospitals in mainland China in 2011
finding: Teenage pregnancies and pregnancies at advanced maternal age (35 years or older) are associated with increased risks of adverse maternal and neonatal outcomes in China.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery rates were higher in the 35-39 year old group and ≥40 year old group compared to the 25-29 year old group.
gest_age: Deliveries after 28 completed weeks of gestation
